# Documentation

This is the central documentation hub for `ether-food`.

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED:docs-index START -->

## 1. Authoritative German game concept

The [German concept](de/index.md) is the content source of truth for game
vision, story, world, mechanics, prototypes, decisions, and approvals. Only
documents with `status: approved` are binding.

## 2. English documentation status

The [English status page](en/index.md) explains why detailed translations are
not available before overall concept completion and source-document approval.

## 3. Technical developer documentation

The [developer area](developer/index.md) contains English game-owned technical
architecture, implementation documentation, decisions, and ExecPlans.

## 4. Inherited Forge2D technical foundation

The [Inherited Forge2D technical foundation](forge2d-template/index.md) preserves
template runtime architecture, tooling, plans, reports, decisions, and release
history. It is not the `ether-food` game concept.

## 5. Reserved future areas

- [Player guide](player-guide/index.md)
- [In-game help](in-game-help/index.md)
- [Case studies](case-studies/index.md)
- [Release manual](release-manual/index.md)

<!-- AUTO-GENERATED:docs-index END -->

Documentation media follows the [media structure](assets/README.md). Repository
workflows are documented in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
